site.title: A website that brings you customers.
site.sub: Shop, company site, online booking or campaign page — fast, beautiful on phones and ready to be found on Google.
site.f1t: Customers don’t wait, so they don’t leave.
site.f2t: Most customers arrive on a phone; it looks right on every screen.
site.f3t: Structure and technical SEO from day one, not later.
site.f4t: Cart, secure payment, appointments and order tracking.
site.f5t: Change products, prices and copy yourself.
site.f6t: Answers visitors’ questions day and night.
site.x5t: Services, case studies and a contact form
site.x6t: One page to sell or sign people up
site.closing: See your website’s design right now — it’s free.
site.q1: How long does a website take?
site.a1: The studio shows the exact time with every choice; simple sites are ready in a few weeks, and you know the delivery date from the start.
site.q2: Do I see the design before paying?
site.a2: Yes. You see the design instantly in the studio, and building doesn’t start until you’re happy.
site.q3: Can I change the content myself later?
site.a3: Yes — with a simple admin panel you change text, images, products and prices yourself.
site.q4: Do you support the site after launch?
site.a4: Yes — launch, training and support after handover are part of our work.

app.title: An app people open every day.
app.sub: iPhone, Android or web app — with timely notifications, one-tap checkout and a loyalty club that brings customers back.
app.f1: iPhone and Android from one codebase
app.f1t: Less than two separate apps would cost, with nothing left out.
app.f2t: The right message lands on the phone at the right moment.
app.f3t: No passwords, secure, in a second.
app.f4t: In-app payment and a cart that’s never lost.
app.f5t: Points, levels and rewards — a reason to come back.
app.f6t: Even with no signal, the app keeps working.
app.closing: Try your app on a phone right now — it’s free.
app.q1: iPhone or Android — which should we build?
app.a1: Usually both, from one shared codebase, which costs less than two separate apps. For a quick start, a web app is a good option too.
app.q2: Do you publish the app to the stores?
app.a2: Yes — preparing and publishing on the App Store and Google Play is on us.
app.q3: Can I try the app before it’s built?
app.a3: Yes — in the studio the app runs on a realistic phone, and you tap through its screens and features.
app.q4: Do you update the app after launch?
app.a4: Yes — support, fixes and new features continue after launch.

ai.title: An agent that gets the job done.
ai.sub: Customer replies, invoice filing, content, reports and forecasts — with your business’s own data and tools, and the final say always yours.
ai.f1t: Replies to customers instantly and logs their orders.
ai.f2t: Gets approvals, files documents and follows up.
ai.f3t: Reads invoices, contracts and forms, and spots mismatches.
ai.f4t: Makes posts, reels and captions and schedules them.
ai.f5t: A ready report every morning, and a warning before stock runs out.
ai.f6t: If you want, everything runs on your own servers.
ai.x5t: Case files, contracts and client reports
ai.x6t: Custom projects: defect detection, failure prediction
ai.closing: Hand the repetitive work to an agent; keep your team’s time for growth.
ai.titleRich: An agent that <g>gets the job done.</g>
ai.demoTitle: Write one sentence; see what it does.
ai.a1: Wherever you want: on a secure cloud or entirely on your own servers, with nothing leaving your organisation.
ai.q2: What if the agent gets something wrong?
ai.a2: You decide which tasks run automatically and which need your approval; sensitive cases always come to you.
ai.q3: Do we need to change our tools?
ai.a3: No — the agent connects to the messengers, shop, accounting and files you already use.
ai.q4: Our needs are specific — can you still help?
ai.a4: Yes — for manufacturing, healthcare, finance or any specific problem we have a custom AI path that starts with a review of your data.
